name: Yatoon Restaurant Menu & Online Ordering
author: yatoon

sections.description:
Yatoon Restaurant Menu & Online Ordering lets restaurants publish a beautiful digital menu and accept orders directly from their WordPress site — no monthly SaaS fees, no commission taken on orders.

Free Features

Menu & Ordering
* Responsive menu with photos, descriptions, modifiers, and pricing
* Featured items carousel, full-text search, sticky category nav
* Cooking preferences — Uber Eats-style chips (spice, salt, oil, sugar, and more) fully configurable from admin
* Special instructions — free-text box on every item so customers can type any request
* Pay-at-restaurant ordering (pickup, delivery, dine-in)
* Scheduled orders, tip options, tax, service fee, and delivery fee
* Coupon / promo code support

Customer Accounts
* Order history with item images, status badges, and “Order again”
* Favorites with item image and direct add-to-cart
* Saved address book — auto-fills delivery field at checkout
* Editable profile (name, phone) and spend statistics
* Native WordPress accounts — no extra tables

Operations
* Kitchen Display ([yatoon_kitchen]) and Order Status page ([yatoon_order_status])
* Real-time new-order browser alerts with sound
* Admin order management with one-click status updates
* Email notifications on every status change (Preparing → Ready → Done)

Upgrade to Pro

Pro adds online payment processing, SMS notifications, and social login:

  • Stripe credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay
  • Alipay and WeChat Pay
  • Twilio SMS order notifications
  • Google, Facebook, Instagram social login

Shortcodes

  • [yatoon_menu] — full menu with cart and checkout
  • [yatoon_kitchen] — real-time kitchen display
  • [yatoon_order_status] — customer order tracking page

External Services

Free version uses no external services. Freemius SDK is bundled for licensing — no data sent unless you connect an account.
* Freemius: https://freemius.com/ · Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/
sections.installation:
1. Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin → upload ZIP → Activate
  2. Yatoon Restaurant Menu → Settings — configure your restaurant
  3. Add [yatoon_menu] to any page
sections.changelog:
1.5.0

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org.
  • Responsive menu, pay-at-restaurant ordering, customer accounts, kitchen display, and admin order management included.
